faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything about employer-paid, organized home-to-work commuting.
faq.stillNeedHelpDesc: Our bilingual team replies within one business day.

general.a1: CarpoolWork is an employer-organized, employer-paid home-to-work carpooling platform. Coworkers commuting to the same site form groups of 2 to 4 and carpool together. The employer pays the subscription; for employees, the platform is free.
general.a2: Employers whose teams travel to the same site every day: offices, hospitals, plants, warehouses, distribution centres and business parks — especially where parking is tight or costly.
general.q3: How is it different from Uber or long-distance carpooling?
general.a3: It's neither ride-hailing nor intercity carpooling. CarpoolWork covers only the recurring home-to-work commute, among coworkers, coordinated and funded by the employer.
general.a4: Nothing to CarpoolWork: the employer pays the subscription. Within a group, coworkers may share the actual costs of the trip (fuel, parking) with no profit for the driver — no payment goes through the platform.
general.a5: Yes. The platform and support are fully available in French and English.

employers.a1: $25 per active participant, per month, with a floor of $500 per month per site. You pay only for people who actually carpool that month.
employers.a2: An employee who logs at least one carpool commute during the month. No carpool that month = not billed for that person.
employers.a3: Each active site (support, posters, QR onboarding) is billed at least $500 per month, only in months where at least one carpool is logged there. Once a site passes 20 active participants, billing moves to the per-participant rate.
employers.a4: Monthly, in arrears, on the real count of active participants for the month. You receive an invoice payable by bank transfer, Interac or cheque — no credit card. Cancellation with 30 days' notice, no long lock-in.
employers.a5: Yes. The pilot runs 10 weeks at one site: a 30-day free trial, then $25 per active participant per month ($500 per site minimum). No commitment beyond the pilot; you receive an impact report at the end.
employers.q6: What's the return for the employer?
employers.a6: Fewer parking spots to provide, lower commuting-related (Scope 3) emissions, a valued staff benefit, and measurable participation data.
employers.a7: At any time, by email to support@carpoolwork.ca, with 30 days' notice. The current month is billed on participants who were actually active; nothing is billed after that.

employees.q1: How do I join the program?
employees.a1: With the code, invite link or QR code from your employer. Create an account or sign in, and you're linked to your company.
employees.a2: You form a group of 2 to 4 coworkers who live or pass nearby. The group commutes together to work.
employees.a3: You take turns — the group sets the driver rotation. On the days you ride as a passenger, you save on fuel, vehicle wear and parking.
employees.q4: How do I record a commute?
employees.a4: The driver of the day taps "We carpooled today" once. The trip is then logged automatically for every active member of the group — nobody has to record their own.
employees.q5: What if I can't carpool some days?
employees.a5: No problem: carpool only on the days that work for you. You're counted only when you actually carpool.
employees.a6: Yes, at any time, from the "My carpool" page.

safety.a1: No. You carpool with your own coworkers, in groups you choose yourself.
safety.a2: Home-to-work carpooling with no profit for the driver (simple cost-sharing) is generally a matter for the driver's personal auto insurance, which is mandatory in Canada. Each driver should confirm with their insurer that their policy covers passengers. CarpoolWork does not provide insurance and is not involved in any payment between coworkers.
safety.a3: Yes. We comply with PIPEDA (Canada's federal privacy law). Our privacy policy details what we collect, where data is hosted and how to access or delete it.

account.a1: Sign up with your email in under 2 minutes.
account.q2: How do I connect to my employer?
account.a2: Enter the join code, open the invite link, or scan the QR poster at your workplace.
account.a3: Yes. Under PIPEDA you can request export or deletion of your data at support@carpoolwork.ca. It is removed within 30 days, except records the law requires us to keep.
account.a4: Email and password. To reset a password, email support@carpoolwork.ca.

support.a1: Email support@carpoolwork.ca — bilingual support, reply within one business day. You can also use the built-in assistant at the bottom of the page.
support.q2: I'm an employer — how do I start?
support.a2: Request a pilot from the Employers page. We set up your site, posters and QR onboarding.

kb.whatIsIt: CarpoolWork is an employer-paid, organized home-to-work carpooling platform. Coworkers heading to the same workplace form groups and commute together. The employer pays; for employees it's free.

kb.driver: Group members take turns driving, on a rotation you decide. On the days you ride as a passenger, you save on fuel, wear and parking.
kb.validation: The driver of the day taps "We carpooled today" once. The trip is logged automatically for every active member of the group — nobody has to record their own.
kb.joinEmployee: To join: use the code, invite link or QR code from your employer, then create an account or sign in.
kb.employerStart: Employer? Request a pilot from the Employers page. We set up your site, posters and QR onboarding to measure adoption and parking impact.
kb.safety: You carpool with your own coworkers, in groups you choose — never with strangers.
kb.insurance: Carpooling with no profit for the driver (cost-sharing) is generally a matter for the driver's personal auto insurance, mandatory in Canada. Confirm with your insurer that your policy covers passengers. CarpoolWork does not provide insurance.
kb.dataPrivacy: We comply with PIPEDA. You can request access to, export of, or deletion of your data at support@carpoolwork.ca; it's removed within 30 days, except what the law requires us to keep.
kb.account: Sign up with your email in under 2 minutes, then link to your employer with the code, link or QR code they gave you.
kb.support: For any help, email support@carpoolwork.ca — bilingual support, reply within one business day.
